name: Dice and cube face relationships
definition: On a standard die opposite faces add to seven, and on any cube the three faces meeting at a corner are mutually adjacent. Most dice problems are solved by naming which faces are opposite before worrying about what you can see.
recognizeWhen: opposite faces of the die add to seven
the dice are stacked on top of each other
what number is on the hidden face
the cube is rolled over onto its side
misconceptions: I assumed the faces I could see were opposite each other.
I forgot that a die rolling over changes which face is down.
I used the opposite-faces rule on a cube that was not a standard die.
